name: biomed-workbench
description: Unified biomedical research and publication assistant with one Codex skill entry and automatic scientific workflow routing.

interface.shortDescription: Unified biomedical research toolbox for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A unified assistant that exposes one biomed-workbench skill and routes biomedical research tasks across evidence, omics, molecular design, imaging, clinical research, experiments, and publication workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use biomed-workbench to analyze this biomedical task and choose the right tools.
Use biomed-workbench for single-cell analysis and Nature-style result writing.
Use biomed-workbench to search evidence, run relevant analysis, and draft a publication-grade output.
Use biomed-workbench to turn this paper into a manuscript, rebuttal, patent, or PPT plan.
